mapper.select: SELECT A.ALBUM_ID, A.SCOPE_TYPE, A.SCOPE_ID, A.ALBUM_NAME, A.ALBUM_DESCRIPTION, A.COVER_PHOTO_ID, A.CREATED_BY, U.USER_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(A.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHOTO_POSTS PP WHERE PP.ALBUM_ID = A.ALBUM_ID) AS POST_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHOTOS P JOIN PHOTO_POSTS PP ON PP.POST_ID = P.POST_ID WHERE PP.ALBUM_ID = A.ALBUM_ID) AS PHOTO_COUNT, CP.FILE_PATH AS COVER_PATH FROM PHOTO_ALBUMS A JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = A.CREATED_BY LEFT JOIN PHOTOS CP ON CP.PHOTO_ID = A.COVER_PHOTO_ID WHERE A.SCOPE_TYPE = #{scopeType} AND A.SCOPE_ID = #{scopeId} ORDER BY A.UPDATED_AT DESC, A.ALBUM_ID DESC

SELECT A.ALBUM_ID, A.SCOPE_TYPE, A.SCOPE_ID, A.ALBUM_NAME, A.ALBUM_DESCRIPTION, A.COVER_PHOTO_ID, A.CREATED_BY, U.USER_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(A.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHOTO_POSTS PP WHERE PP.ALBUM_ID = A.ALBUM_ID) AS POST_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHOTOS P JOIN PHOTO_POSTS PP ON PP.POST_ID = P.POST_ID WHERE PP.ALBUM_ID = A.ALBUM_ID) AS PHOTO_COUNT FROM PHOTO_ALBUMS A JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = A.CREATED_BY WHERE A.ALBUM_ID = #{albumId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_PHOTO_ALBUM_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PHOTO_ALBUMS ( ALBUM_ID, SCOPE_TYPE, SCOPE_ID, ALBUM_NAME, ALBUM_DESCRIPTION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{albumId}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{albumName}, #{albumDescription,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE PHOTO_ALBUMS SET ALBUM_NAME = #{albumName}, ALBUM_DESCRIPTION = #{albumDescription,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ALBUM_ID = #{albumId}
mapper.sql: PP.POST_ID, PP.SCOPE_TYPE, PP.SCOPE_ID, PP.ALBUM_ID, A.ALBUM_NAME, PP.TITLE, PP.DESCRIPTION, PP.CREATED_BY, U.USER_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, TO_CHAR(PP.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(PP.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHOTOS PX WHERE PX.POST_ID = PP.POST_ID) AS PHOTO_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_REACTIONS CR WHERE CR.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO_POST' AND CR.CONTENT_ID = PP.POST_ID AND CR.REACTION_TYPE = 'LIKE') AS LIKE_COUNT, CASE WHEN #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_REACTIONS CR WHERE CR.CONTENT_TYPE = 'PHOTO_POST' AND CR.CONTENT_ID = PP.POST_ID AND CR.USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND CR.REACTION_TYPE = 'LIKE' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LIKED_BY_ME, (SELECT FILE_PATH FROM ( SELECT PX.FILE_PATH FROM PHOTOS PX WHERE PX.POST_ID = PP.POST_ID ORDER BY PX.SORT_ORDER ASC, PX.PHOTO_ID ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS COVER_PATH
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PHOTO_POSTS PP JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = PP.CREATED_BY LEFT JOIN PHOTO_ALBUMS A ON A.ALBUM_ID = PP.ALBUM_ID WHERE PP.POST_ID = #{postId}

SELECT P.PHOTO_ID, P.POST_ID, P.ALBUM_ID, P.FILE_PATH, P.ORIGINAL_NAME, P.FILE_SIZE, P.MIME_TYPE, P.UPLOADED_BY, U.USER_NAME AS UPLOADER_NAME, TO_CHAR(P.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT FROM PHOTOS P JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = P.UPLOADED_BY WHERE P.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY P.SORT_ORDER ASC, P.PHOTO_ID ASC
